metadata.title: fix: cache legacy API token JTI lookups to reduce DB sessions
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Add thread-safe in-memory cache (60s TTL) to `_is_api_token_jti_sync()` so legacy tokens without `auth_provider` skip the `fresh_db_session()` + DB query on repeat requests
- Fold the API token JTI query into `_get_auth_context_batched_sync()` (query 4) so it reuses the same DB session as user lookup, personal team, and token revocation checks — priming the cache in the process
- Periodic cache eviction at 500 entries to bound memory

Fail-closed behavior is preserved: DB errors still treat the token as an API token.

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify legacy tokens (no `auth_provider` claim) still authenticate correctly
- [ ] Verify modern tokens with `auth_provider` are unaffected
- [ ] Confirm `_is_api_token_jti_sync` returns cached result on second call within 60s
